parityFields: final-state fields (messageOrder, toolCallOrder, sharedState, pendingToolCallIds, runStatus) x full/resume
final-state hash (shared parity projection) x full/resume
definitions.parityProjection: FIX-R2 (§3.6-A, ADR-003): the parity projection is a differential projection of the production projectState — full runs (outcome/result/error/parentRunId/protocolVersion), verbatim message toolCalls, plus the derived timeline runId (run events take the event runId, other items take the current RUNNING run's runId, absent when no run is open); parity path = production path + runStatus
definitions.firstDivergenceDefinition: T004 step comparison (PROJECT_BOOK §8.6): align by sourceIndex, step through canonical states from the checkpoint, first differing position — diagnostic sourceIndex (e.g. G01 DUPLICATE_TOOL_CALL at 2) is a different value and is NOT the first divergence (4)
definitions.reportHashDefinition: JCS canonicalHash of the rejoinlab.report/v1 report with metrics.durationMs removed; metrics.visitedStates retained
definitions.parityReportHashDefinition: FIX-R2: JCS canonicalHash of the FULL production report hash input (diagnostics with message/evidence, firstDivergence in full, input, recovery, assumptions, limitations, metrics.visitedStates) with both paths in parity projection (production path + runStatus)
definitions.productionReportHashDefinition: FIX-R2 (R-10): JCS canonicalHash of the production report exactly as the product emits it (buildReportFromAnalysis + reportHash), minus metrics.durationMs — no field excluded
definitions.convergenceDefinition: legalBaseline() (correct checkpoint, no injections): fullStateHash === resumeStateHash and no CRITICAL diagnostic
